results.heading: Bulk excavation in area number 1 of scheduled areas
results.excerpt:
25.
Bulk excavation in area number 1 of scheduled areas
(1)
In this section—
bulk excavation (大型挖掘工程) means any kind of excavation except excavation for—
(a)
ground investigation;
(b)
public utility trenches;
(c)
drains;
(d)
sewers; or
(e)
pile installation;
cumulative adverse effect (累積不利影響), in relation to area number 1 of the scheduled areas, means the overall adverse effects on the stability of the hillside in the area due to bulk excavation at 2 or more sites in the area.
(2)
Bulk excavation carried out in area number 1 of the scheduled areas must be limited to a level that minimizes the cumulative adverse effect to the area.

Foundation plan to be submitted with site formation plan

results.heading: Floor and adjoining ground surface
results.excerpt:
33.
Floor and adjoining ground surface
(1)
The ground surface within the external walls of a building must be covered with a suitable material to prevent moisture penetration.
(2)
Adequate means must be provided to prevent ingress of water from the ground surface outside a building to the adjoining floor of the building.
(3)
To carry away any surface water on the ground surface (except in any landscaped area) outside a building, the surface must be provided with paving laid to an adequate gradient to direct the water to flow into a surface water drain.
